verdict.rationale: OpenTofu keeps infrastructure definitions in human-readable configuration files that users version and share themselves, under a stable open-source license. As a drop-in replacement for Terraform that supports both .tf and .tofu files, configurations stay portable to the upstream tool rather than locked in. However, the evidence never documents the state file format as open or exportable, and offers no explicit export or exit workflow. missing for 10: documentation that state files use an open format, an explicit export or migration-out path, independent reports of leaving OpenTofu (community reports only cover migrating in).
